lines.text: Brimstone Maiden. Ninety days overdue. Let's go collect.
Smells like a salad bar died in here.
Blue card. Now we're getting somewhere.
Yellow card. Cargo, here I come.
Red card. Let's go see the bridge.
Lights are on. Now I can see what's eating me.
Tram's open. Somebody's waiting, aren't they.
Agent Hammersmith. Account: Brimstone Maiden. Status: delinquent. Last contact, nine days ago. Recover the vessel. Payment plans are not authorized.
lines.speaker: dispatch

lines.text: Nine days with no contact... Somebody's behind on more than rent.
Clamps are holding. Lights aren't. Nobody's home.
Those aren't on the work order.
